mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1800K units signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1800K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of other market conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, it signals a tight labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 200K, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when INDPRO > 6mo MA are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of instances when GDPC1 annual growth < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 1.5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth rate exceeds 3% YoY, it signals tightening monetary policy with elevated inflation concerns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the level of payroll employment (PAYEMS) is a persistent driver of economic activity, with higher levels of employment leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, regardless of other market conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positively correlated with PAYEMS levels (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the level of retail and food services sales (RSAFS) exceeds its 3-month moving average and housing starts (HOUST) are above 1600K, it signals broadening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of instances when RSAFS > 3mo MA and HOUST > 1600K, or Rank IC < 0.018 over any 2-year rolling window.
